subject: QBR launch cadence & risk ledger — final decisions
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: QBR: Launch cadence & risk ledger — draft for review

Team,

Attached is the first pass of the QBR launch risk ledger and a proposed 8-week rollout timeline for the Acme integration (risk_ledger_v1.xlsx, rollout_timeline_v2.pdf). High-level summary:

- OKR impact: This launch maps to Goal B.2 (Embed Redwood in Acme search pipeline). We are currently at ~60% of acceptance criteria for GA.
- Major open risks: model latency at 99th pctl under peak (eng), SSO + audit log retention confirmations (security/procurement), and billing integration for metered usage.
- Suggested priority: focus on latency fixes and SSO evidence for procurement; defer feature X (advanced reranking UI) to post-GA.

Requests:
1) Marcus — can you add ETA ranges for the four engineering tickets in tab ‘Eng-Tasks’ by EOD Friday? Call out which require infra (Dedicated) changes.
2) Laura — please mark which acceptance criteria are negotiable vs must-have for our Q2 GA.
3) Vivek — want to flag any exec asks we should surface in the QBR slides; I’ll draft the 1-slide ask once scope is confirmed.

I’ll open a canary plan doc once we lock the minimal scope.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Delivery | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (555) 212-3344

Attachments: risk_ledger_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), rollout_timeline_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: QBR: Launch cadence & risk ledger — draft for review

Thanks Mina — quick engine-side update.

- Ticket ENG-432: KV cache lock contention under 10k concurrency — mitigation in review, ETA 10–14 days (needs a kernel tweak, low infra change).
- Ticket ENG-447: 99p latency regression for sequence len 1–16 on A100 — root cause pinned to attention fusion path; working on a fallback that regresses costs ~4% but meets SLO. ETA 7 days for canary.
- Ticket ENG-451: Autoscaler mis-fire on burst traffic — blocked on Dedicated autoscale policy change from infra (need infra-owner sign-off).
- Ticket ENG-459: Add telemetry stopgaps for SSO audit logs — quick patch ready, ETA 2 days.

Blockers: infra owner for autoscale policy and a clean repro for the attention regression at scale (we have local repro, but need a staging run on a large pod).

I’ll drop updated ETAs into the Eng-Tasks tab by EOD.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: QBR: Launch cadence & risk ledger — draft for review

Appreciate the draft. A couple of product-level clarifications:

- Acceptance criteria: I’ve annotated the Google doc (link below) — must-haves for GA are: SSO + audit logs, basic prompt templates, embeddings backfill for historic data, billing contract. All other UX polish can be pushed to post-GA.
- Feature X (reranking UI): can be delayed if engineering confirms latency fix is in the canary and SLA targets are met.
- Timeline: given Marcus’s ETAs, suggest shifting GA target by one sprint (2 weeks) to allow for robust canary. That keeps customer expectation intact but buys engineering runway.

Action: Mina, can you confirm we communicate a GA window (target: July 12–26) to Acme and give procurement a firm doc for audit logs this week?

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-risk-ledger (annotated)

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior PM, Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Keller <jkeller@acme.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: QBR: Launch cadence & risk ledger — Acme timing and procurement

Mina / team — thanks for the detail. Quick notes from Acme:

- Procurement needs explicit retention windows and evidence for audit logs (SOC/ISO references acceptable). Can you send the data retention matrix and sample logs?
- GA window is fine; the business wants a hard opt-in deadline for the billing ramp so they can schedule a finance review (we’re targeting July payroll).
- Can you confirm whether the canary will include our active traffic and how rollback will work? We need a short doc for our compliance team.

We appreciate the proposed timeline. If you can send the canary plan draft and the retention matrix this week, we’ll aim to triangle procurement sign-off.

Jordan Keller
Director, Search Integrations | Acme Corp
jkeller@acme.com | +1 617-555-0199

Attachment: acme_procurement_timeline.xlsx (reference)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: QBR: Launch cadence & risk ledger — alignment and exec ask

Good thread — two tactical items from me:

1) Prioritization: Accept the one-sprint shift. We must guarantee a clean canary and SSO/audit evidence for procurement. Marking latency fixes and audit logs as must-haves (blocking GA).
2) Exec slide: Mina — please prepare a one-slide ask for the QBR summarizing (a) minimal scope for GA, (b) delta to full product, (c) top three risks and mitigations. I’ll present.
3) Canary policy: keep traffic at 10% for two weeks with automated rollback on 99p latency breach and error-rate bump >0.5%. Marcus, coordinate the autoscale policy change with infra this week.

If we can lock these by Friday, I’ll approve an exception for a modest credit to Acme (to smooth procurement) if we commit to the GA window.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Keller <jkeller@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: QBR: Launch cadence & risk ledger — final decisions and next steps

Jordan / Acme procurement — thanks for the prompt responses. Quick summary of decisions and next steps (finalized):

1) Scope for GA (minimal): SSO + audit logs, billing integration, backfill embeddings, core inference endpoints (no advanced reranking UI).
2) Timeline: Target GA window confirmed as July 12–26. We will begin a 10% canary on June 28, run for two weeks, and expand pending criteria.
3) Canary plan (attached canary_plan_draft.docx): includes rollback thresholds (99p latency, error-rate >0.5%), monitoring owners, and runbook. Marcus — please validate autoscale policy change and confirm staging run availability.
4) Procurement artifacts: attached is the retention matrix and sample log extract (see Drive link). Mina will drop SOC/ISO artifact references to the shared drive by EOD.
5) Commercial note: Vivek approved a discretionary credit subject to on-time GA and SLA attainment. Details to be handled by sales ops.

Action owners and deadlines (short):
- Marcus: Eng ETAs in Eng-Tasks tab (EOD May 28) — ONGOING
- Mina: Upload SOC/ISO refs + final risk_ledger_v2.xlsx (EOD May 28) — COMPLETED
- Laura: Confirm acceptance criteria doc updates (May 30)
- Jordan/Acme: Procurement sign-off target (June 10)

Thanks everyone — I’ll put the one-slide exec ask in the QBR deck and share for review Monday.

Mina Haddad
Director, Customer Delivery | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: canary_plan_draft.docx (docx), risk_ledger_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
